title: FTSE 350 Chairs Report Published
description: New report and infographic from FTSE Women Leaders Review examining the future of FTSE 350 chairs, authored by Professor Esser.

title: Leading from the Boardroom: Governance, Skills and Impact
description: Upcoming Executive Education 1-day programme at the University of Glasgow, led by Professor Esser alongside Dr Anthony Devine, Dr Catriona Cannon and Professor Graeme Roy, covering corporate governance, ESG, and board effectiveness, with guest speaker Megan Pantelides of Board Intelligence.

title: IoD Launches Commission on Business as a Force for Good
description: The Institute of Directors has launched a new Commission to examine how business creates economic, social, and environmental value, and how directors, boards, and policymakers can support long-term prosperity and wellbeing.

title: University of Glasgow School of Law Highly Commended at LexisNexis Legal Awards 2026
description: The University of Glasgow School of Law was highly commended in the University Commercial Impact Award at the LexisNexis Legal Awards 2026, recognising the wider impact of its legal education.
imageAlt: LexisNexis Legal Awards 2026 graphic showing University of Glasgow Law School as highly commended in the University Commercial Impact Award.

title: Oxford Business Law Blog: The Challenge of Deploying Comply or Explain in Scottish Higher Education Governance
description: New blog post on the Oxford Business Law Blog discussing the challenge of deploying comply or explain in Scottish higher education governance.

title: NEDs Reimagined Report Published
description: The IoD Centre for Corporate Governance publishes the NEDs Reimagined report, co-authored by Professor Esser, reassessing the role of non-executive directors more than twenty years after the Higgs Review.

title: Reimagining Non-Executive Directors Event
description: Launch event for the NEDs Reimagined report at the Institute of Directors, London, bringing together directors, governance professionals, and policymakers.

title: Anthropy 2026
description: I am looking forward to joining 2,000 cross-sector leaders at #Anthropy26, where we will explore a brighter vision for Britain over the next 30 years. I am excited to play my part in inspiring a more united future for the United Kingdom. I will be there from 25-27 March at the Eden Project, Cornwall.

title: ESG Ratings Activities Regulation: A Commentary
description: Out now - The Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Ratings Activities Regulation: A Commentary. Edited by Andrea Miglionico, Associate Professor, School of Law University of Reading, UK. Available in print and eBook through our website. Available for your law firm or institution through Elgaronline, where Chapter 1 is currently free to access.

title: New Article
description: New article on Corporate Governance and Higher Education.

title: Shortlisted: LexisNexis
description: Very excited to be shortlisted for the LexisNexis UK legal awards. This is for the work done by our incredible Commercial Law Team at the University of Glasgow School of Law. In the category: University Commercial Impact Award — this category recognises universities that excel in equipping their law students with strong commercial awareness and strategic thinking skills.
